title: Budu Dogon
extract: Budu Dogon or Bunoge, also known as Korandabo, is a Dogon language spoken in Mali. It was first reported online around 2005. The plural suffix on nouns is closest to Kolum so, suggesting it should be classified as a West Dogon language.
